top_signals.title: Zero-click spyware infecting devices through online ads, researchers say

top_signals.title: Indonesia Outflows to Worsen as MSCI Mulls Cut, Analysts Say
top_signals.summary: Indonesian stocks will likely see further outflows as the nation faces a potential ejection from global stock indexes following MSCI Inc.’s latest proposal to downgrade the country, according to analysts.

top_signals.title: PJM, ERCOT, and SWPP all set peak load records this summer
top_signals.summary: Three regional transmission organizations (RTOs) set records for peak hourly load this past summer, according to data reported on Form EIA-930 and presented in the Hourly Electric Grid Monitor.

top_signals.title: U.S. Targets Central Asia's Energy and Critical Minerals in Major Trade Push
top_signals.summary: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio will meet the foreign ministers of the Central Asian republics - Kazakhstan, the Kyrgyz Republic, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan - in Samarkand, Uzbekistan on 19 October 2026. Rubio will be accompanied by a delegation of more than 100 U.S. companies. Washington has framed the agenda around economic connectivity, energy security, and shared regional priorities.
